note: Invented phases of a cabinet-making project.

phases.title: Measure the alcove
phases.text: Three heights and three widths; the wall is out of true by 6 mm.

phases.title: Cut the carcass
phases.text: 18 mm birch ply, nested on two sheets with 4 mm kerf.

phases.title: Dry fit
phases.text: Dominos in every joint, clamped without glue for a day.

phases.title: Glue up
phases.text: Two people, one open time of twelve minutes.

phases.title: Hang the doors
phases.text: Concealed hinges, 2 mm reveal all round.

phases.title: Oil the fronts
phases.text: Two coats, a day apart, rubbed back between.

phases.title: Fit and scribe
phases.text: Scribe the end panel to the wall with a compass.
